facts.fact: Nukta Habari reports the Bank of Tanzania's August 2024 guidance for Tier 2 digital lenders aims to enforce financial consumer protection rules on transparency, charges, debt collection and customer data privacy.
facts.system: Guidance Note on Digital Lenders under Tier 2 Microfinance Service Providers, 2024

facts.fact: Nukta Habari reports the Bank of Tanzania on 21 November 2024 cancelled the permits of 69 online lending apps for breaching licence conditions, including failing to protect customer privacy.
facts.system: Guidance Note on Digital Lenders under Tier 2 Microfinance Service Providers, 2024
